pages.title: Wavefunction
pages.text: Everything a particle could be, written as one complex-valued function. Its square gives the probability of finding the particle anywhere. The function hovers above the palm as a faint, shifting haze that never settles into one shape.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Combining a qubit with the complex plane on a foam substrate, and adding Schrodinger's Limit, I described a particle's state completely. The Analytic Continuator called it a wavefunction.
